findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_service_area, request_apostille, request_booking, search_documentation · Private data: check_request_status, get_apostille_requirements, get_price_quote, request_apostille, request_booking, request_price_match, search_documentation · Public sink: request_apostille, request_booking, request_price_match, reschedule_booking · Destructive: request_booking.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_service_area, request_apostille, request_booking, search_documentation · Private data: check_request_status, get_apostille_requirements, get_price_quote, request_apostille, request_booking, request_price_match, search_documentation · Public sink: request_apostille, request_booking, request_price_match, reschedule_booking · Destructive: request_booking

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
